ns2:section.sectionText: This course is for Freshman and Sophomore students interested in learning more about the field of economics, including career opportunities, graduate programs, and academic planning. The seminar will not fulfill any hours in economics or any specific requirements, but will be counted towards overall hours. If you are not declared as economics, but interested in the major, please contact Kari Hutjens (kmcdanie@illinois.edu) or Melissa Newell (menewell@illinois.edu) for a possible override.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
